newsitem.title: USA: Helicopter crashes in New York City river.
newsitem.headline: Helicopter crashes in New York City river.

text.p: A helicopter crashed Tuesday afternoon into the East River in New York City, police said.
Two victims were rescued from the water and removed in ambulances, a spokesman for the New York City Fire Department said.
Two other people were believed to be in the water, the Fire Department said.
The crash occurred at the 60th Street heliport, which is along the East River on Manhattan's Upper East Side.
A reporter on board a WNBC television traffic helicopter said the accident involved a corporate helicopter with four people on board that crashed while trying to land at the heliport.
The report of the crash came in at 5:36 p.m., the Fire Department said.
